transactionbodycustomfield.description: When pricing is determined relative to material receipt for this Sustana Recovery PO.
transactionbodycustomfield.help: Drives PO + IR + Settlement behavior. Known at PO = price committed at PO entry (vendor specifies composition). Determined on Arrival = price set at IR after inspection. Determined After Processing = vendor brings unknown-yield material; PO uses generic placeholder item at $0; final price determined post-WIP via Settlement Calculator mode.
